title: Family in Sunday Best, Bellaire Texas Church - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Bellaire, Texas March 29, 1953 151 My new hat looks like a beret but doesn't in the least actually! Off to Church! —
description: A charming snapshot of a smiling mother posed with her young son and daughter in front of their suburban home in Bellaire, Texas, on March 29, 1953. The family is dressed in their Sunday best on Palm Sunday, prepared to leave for church. The mother wears a fashionable mid-century skirt and dark hat, the young girl wears a dress with white gloves, and the young boy is dressed in a dark vest and trousers. They stand beside a low brick planter box filled with flowering petunias beneath a wide window with Venetian blinds, exemplifying the quintessential post-WWII suburban American family lifestyle.
